revenue_scope: Vanflyta revenue row in Daiichi Sankyo's table 'Revenue by Business Units and Products', Oncology Business Unit section
geography: The table prints no geography for the row; the Japan Business Unit product list in the same table does not list Vanflyta. Daiichi Sankyo's pipeline pages give the brand as 'VANFLYTA (JP/US/EU/CN)'.
moa: FLT3 inhibitor (Daiichi Sankyo pipeline page: 'Quizartinib/AC220 (FLT3 inhibitor)'), indicated for FLT3-ITD-positive acute myeloid leukemia

approval_evidence.quote: NDA 216993 NDA APPROVAL ... for VANFLYTA (quizartinib) tablets ... newly diagnosed acute myeloid leukemia (AML) that is FLT3 internal tandem duplication (ITD)-positive ... [electronically signed 07/20/2023]

series_start_reason: Daiichi Sankyo prints a Vanflyta revenue row only from its FY2024 Q1 Reference Data; its prior-year columns show FY2023 Q1 (April-June 2023) as nil and the first revenue in FY2023 Q2 (July-September 2023 = 2023Q3). No Daiichi Sankyo document located gives the launch quarter, so launch_quarter is null.
notes: Currency JPY, not converted; values printed to 0.1 billion JPY, so single-quarter precision is coarse. The row sits under the Oncology Business Unit heading with no geographic label. 2023Q3, 2023Q4 and 2024Q1 are comparative columns of the FY2024 documents because FY2023 documents have no Vanflyta revenue row. The USD Mn 'Revenue in Local Currency' table of the same documents prints the same line in integer US dollars millions.
search_log: Read the Daiichi Sankyo quarterly-results index (daiichisankyo.com/investors/library/quarterly_result/) and used the Reference Data PDFs of FY2019 (full year), FY2020 Q1-Q4, FY2021 Q1-Q4, FY2022 Q1-Q4, FY2023 Q1-Q4, FY2024 Q1-Q4, FY2025 Q1-Q4 and FY2026 Q1 (26 documents); every document was opened with pdfplumber (the verifier's extractor) and every line mentioning the brand or its generic name was listed per page. Not scanned: Reference Data of FY2019 Q1-Q3 and earlier, which were not located on the index pages available; the FY2019 full-year document prints no revenue row for either Daiichi Sankyo oncology brand in this batch.
Fiscal year runs April to March: fiscal Q1 = April-June = calendar Q2, Q2 = July-September = calendar Q3, Q3 = October-December = calendar Q4, Q4 = January-March = calendar Q1 of the next year.

Each Reference Data PDF carries the table '3. Revenue by Business Units and Products (2)' in JPY Bn with columns for the four quarters and full year of the prior fiscal year and of the current fiscal year, and a parallel table '3. Revenue by Business Units and Products (3)' marked '[Reference] Revenue in Local Currency' in USD Mn. The JPY Bn table was used for the whole series so one currency runs throughout; the USD Mn table is the same line in integer US dollars millions and is not delivered.
Column position (not text order) was used to read each quarter: blank future cells print nothing or '-' so the current-quarter cell is the Nth cell after the five prior-year cells.

Vanflyta: the FY2023 Reference Data (Q1-Q4, urls under /2023/) contain no line mentioning the Vanflyta brand at all (FY2020-FY2022 documents mention it on pipeline pages as 'Brand name: VANFLYTA (JP)'), so there is no revenue row for it. The first revenue row is in the FY2024 Q1 document, whose prior-year columns print FY2023 Q1-Q4 as '-', 1.1, 0.2, 0.5 (full year 1.9). FY2023 Q1 is a printed nil and is not included; FY2023 Q2, Q3 and Q4 (calendar 2023Q3, 2023Q4, 2024Q1) are direct_prior_year_column rows read from the FY2024 Q2, Q3 and Q4 documents respectively; FY2024 Q1 onward are read as current.
Fiscal-year checks: FY2023 1.1+0.2+0.5=1.8 (printed 1.9); FY2024 0.9+0.8+1.3+1.6=4.6 (4.5); FY2025 1.9+1.9+2.2+2.2=8.2 (8.2). Differences are rounding of quarterly cells to 0.1.

The Japan Business Unit product list of the same table (Lixiana, Tarlige, Pralia, Enhertu and others) does not list Vanflyta, and the only Vanflyta row is under the Oncology Business Unit; the documents scanned do not say whether Japanese sales are inside that row, so the geography is left as unlabelled.
FDA approval letter NDA 216993 (accessdata.fda.gov, signed 07/20/2023) read for approval year; Daiichi Sankyo pipeline text in the FY2026 Q1 document lists 'May 2023: Approved (JP)'.
